channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Staples Center | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Staples Center from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Paul George on Staples Center
item.description:
the late-night host ran a clip of Los Angeles Clippers forward Paul George — a Palmdale native who’s been a Clipper since 2019 — lamenting the change from the only name the place has had since it opened in October 1999.

“It’ll be weird ... You know, I grew up [with] this being Staples and Staples being, you know, the place to play and the place to be,”

Paul George on Staples Center, Nov 18, 2021. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Staples Center
item.description:
“We kind of just see it like everybody else and we saw it today, not really knowing the details of it. But it’s the Staples Center. The Staples Center has got so many great memories, just for me as a kid, growing up in L.A. So many great things have happened in that building. Regardless of the name, the building is still the building and that’s what’s most important and that’s all you can think about.”

Russell Westbrook on Staples Center, Nov 18, 2021. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Trevor Noah on Staples Center
item.description:
“You know, it’s not like Staples is a sacred name from the ancestors. It’s a store where you buy 50 packs of binders even though you only need one. Then when you get home, you find out they were the wrong size anyway. “You don’t need to get that nostalgic about it. It’s a company.”

Trevor Noah on Staples Center, Nov 18, 2021. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Staples Center
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Frank Vogel on Staples Center name change:

“It's tough. Lakers fans, and really sports fans in general, obviously know that building as the Staples Center. I understand the disappointment the fans will have,but that's just the way of the world. This is the business we're in. Almost universally around the country, there's a business element to naming rights with arenas. It's really out of our control.”

Frank Vogel on Staples Center, Nov 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: LeBron James on Staples Center
item.description:
“I would love for us to start having fans here in California, especially here at Staples. It would just add so much for us — also, to see our fans too. It’s very challenging.”

LeBron James on Staples Center, Mar 1, 2021. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: LeBron James on Staples Center
item.description:
“And then being at Staples Center, I've gotten the opportunity to play here on Christmas as a Laker and also as an opponent. It's just a beautiful feeling being here.”

LeBron James on Staples Center, Dec 25, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Chris Paul on Staples Center
item.description:
“I don’t know. For some reason we just haven’t made it a tough place to play. “ … Obviously it’s our mentality. We’re the ones playing. We have to give our crowd something to cheer about, something to get behind. We’ve got to make Staples Center, for our home games, a tough place to play.”

Chris Paul on Staples Center, Oct 23, 2016. Source: Orange County Register.

item.title: Adam Silver on Staples Center
item.description:
Mark Medina:Adam Silver:

“It is my honor to announce that the 2018 NBA All-Star game will be here at the Staples Center.”

Adam Silver on Staples Center, Mar 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Jeanie Buss on Staples Center
item.description:
Lakers President and co-owner Jeanie Buss confirmed the news in a statement released by the team:

“We look forward to having Shaq join the other legends who have been honored with statues at Staples Center,”

Jeanie Buss on Staples Center, Jan 28, 2016. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Matt Barnes on Staples Center
item.description:
Ben Bolch:Matt Barnes on Staples Center crowd for Games 1-2:

“It’s been the best I’ve been around, even being with the Lakers or the Clippers.”

Matt Barnes on Staples Center, Apr 27, 2015. Source: Twitter @latbbolch.
